notes: California's 2025-2026 session is a single two-year biennium (Cal. Const. Art. IV §3(a)); nothing dies at end of calendar-year 2025 — unpassed bills carry over as 'two-year bills'. Dates above are the SECOND-YEAR (2026) deadlines (J.R. 61(b)) since this is the operative floor/committee calendar for a bill still pending as of this seed's load date. committeeCutoffDate/secondCommitteeCutoffDate are the POLICY-committee deadlines (fiscal-committee deadlines run ~2 weeks later per J.R. 61(b)(8)/(14) and are not separately modeled here). A distinct Jan 31, 2026 deadline applies only to already-2025-introduced bills that must still pass their house of origin (J.R. 61(b)(3)) — not captured as a separate column.
